key_idea: Pokemon spread freely inside a connected component, so the answer exists iff every component has at least k kids, and then any assignment using all k variants in each component works.
sketch: BFS each component and give the i-th visited kid variant i mod k + 1; if a component ends with fewer than k vertices print impossible. O(n+m). Isolated kids are components of size 1, so k>1 with any isolated vertex is impossible. Multiple answers are valid: samples matched exactly and a random validator (DSU components, all k variants present per component, impossibility agreement) confirmed the output.
